result:
Both bugs are fixed and every screenshot has been re-captured. tv's typecheck, lint and tests all pass (80 tests).

## 1. Cards showing through the side rail
The collapsed rail's background faded from 92% to fully transparent, and rows scrolled across the whole screen width, so cards showed through behind the icons.

- **Rail is now opaque** (`src/components/Rail.tsx`): a solid panel in the screen's background colour, with a short fade past its edge. The fade ends at x=136, where the guide's text begins. My first try used a wider fade, and the re-captured guide screenshot showed it dimming the "I" of "Island Time", so I narrowed it (`RAIL_FADE` in `src/components/layout.ts`). The expanded rail is unchanged.
- **Rows clip at the rail's edge** (`src/components/Shelf.tsx`): each row's scroll area now starts at the rail's edge instead of the screen's. Focused cards still sit in the same place, so scrolling behaves exactly as before. A small helper, `clippedRow` in `src/focus/scroll.ts`, keeps the clip from ever passing the focus line, and it has tests.
- **Screens checked:**
  - Home, Movies, Series, Sports and Kids home all use `Shelf`, so the fix covers them.
  - My list is a grid that starts to the right of the rail and never scrolls sideways, so it needed nothing.
  - The details page has no rail, so its rows (episodes and More like this) still run to the screen edge.

## 2. Placeholder text in the guide preview
Programmes without a synopsis fell back to the text `"<name> on <channel>."`. I removed that fallback, and `src/data/catalog.ts` now requires a synopsis for every programme, so a missing one is a type error.

- I wrote a one-line synopsis for every programme on all eight channels. Programmes that share a name with a catalog title (Island Time, Ashfall, Deep Reef and others) match that title's story.
- Repeat airings get different lines: the two Ghost Lane and two Byte & Bolt slots each describe a different episode.
- Each line is 72 characters or fewer so it fits on one line in the preview panel. A new test in `src/data/catalog.test.ts` enforces this, along with no placeholder text and no duplicates within a channel.

## Screenshots
Every screen with the rail changed, so I re-ran the full capture script. Focus followed the same path as before and no page errors were reported. I looked at 04, 06, 09, 11, 19, 22, 23 and 25:
- **04 (Top 10):** nothing behind the rail; Ember Crown is clipped at the rail's edge, with only a faded sliver showing before the focus line.
- **19 (Live TV guide):** shows "A travel blogger is stuck on an island with her ex and a bossy parrot." on one line.

21 of the 25 screenshots were updated. The player shots (14–18, 21) also changed, but I didn't open those; I assume it's minor pixel differences from re-capturing.

The script's bundled Chromium wasn't installed here, so I ran it with `--chromium /opt/pw-browsers/chromium-1194/chrome-linux/chrome`. Nothing is committed.
